source.name: Bologna FC 1909
source.quote: the Saputo Group logo will be printed on the jerseys of Bologna FC 1909 in the 2023/24 season
source.note: Main Partner since 2023/24; still front-of-shirt in 2026/27 per the kit launch photos and FootyLogos.

source.name: FootyLogos – Bologna 2026-27 kit page
source.quote: The shirt has white Macron branding, the Bologna badge on the chest, Saputo on the front and Selenella on the back.
source.note: Club's long-standing Back Shirt/Back Jersey Partner (bolognafc.it 2024-02-26 and 2024-09-30); the club's official kit article does not name sponsors, and the away-kit write-up places Selenella low on the rear for 2026-27.

source.name: Bologna FC 1909 – Lavoropiù extends Bologna partnership until 2029
source.quote: The employment agency will continue as both a Top Partner and Sleeve Partner , with its logo remaining on the sleeves of all Bologna teams
source.note: Sleeve partner through 2028/29, so Lavoropiù is on the 2026-27 sleeve; also visible on the sleeve in the club's launch photo and Football Shirt Culture's away-kit write-up.

source.name: Eni press release: Enilive becomes Serie A Title sponsor with sponsorship agreement up until 2027
source.quote: Enilive, Eni's company dedicated to mobility products and services, will be the Title sponsor of Serie A starting from the 2024/25 championship and covering three seasons.
source.note: League title sponsor whose branding is on the official Serie A sleeve patch (2026-27 patch on sale as 'Official Italian Serie A enilive 2026-27 Patch'); the patch is visible on the left sleeve of the match photo. Not a direct Bologna club deal.

summary: Saputo front, Selenella back, Lavoropiù sleeve, Serie A Enilive league patch; Macron make. No shorts sponsor on the home kit.
